# Widget `cloze` — Fill the gaps

**Pack:** core

**When to use:** Use for a key definition or rule whose exact wording matters; each {{gap}} hides one important word.

## Example block

```json
{
  "kind": "widget",
  "type": "cloze",
  "title": "Fill the gaps",
  "props": {
    "text": "Photosynthesis turns {{carbon dioxide}} and water into {{glucose}} using light energy.",
    "distractors": [
      "oxygen",
      "starch"
    ]
  }
}
```

## Props

| Field | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | string | yes |
| `distractors` | array of string (0–6) | no |

The validator also checks the cross-field rules (ids that must exist, lengths that must match,
expressions that must parse). Run `npm run validate` after writing a widget.
